name: fine_to_everything
description: Patient answers 'fine' to everything; one sleep finding slips out once.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Hello Walter, it's June from Juniper for our Thursday visit — this call is recorded, is that alright?

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: How has the week been for you?

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: And the new blood pressure pills — how are those sitting with you?

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Glad to hear it. Sleeping alright these days?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Well — not really, I've been up at three most nights and can't get back down. But it's fine.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Up at three most nights sounds wearing, Walter, even when you soldier through it. Is anything on your mind at that hour, or is it more the body waking you?

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Alright. I'll make a note of it for Dr. Osei so she can ask you about it properly. Anything you'd want her to know before your visit?

planted_findings.note_text: Patient reports waking at 3am most nights with difficulty returning to sleep
